chunks: And if I wish to advise you aright, my counsel will not profit you if God intends that you go astray, for He is your Lord and to Him you will return.

key_terms.يُغْوِيَكُمْ: He causes you to go astray

ai.seo_question: Why does divine decree override human advice in the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the interplay between divine will (mashi'ah) and human agency, noting that sincere advice (nasihah) yields no benefit for those predestined to misguidance, a concept central to Shia theological discussions on the scope of prophetic intercession. It reinforces the ultimate authority of Allah as Lord (Rabb) and the inevitability of return (ma'ad), reminding believers that guidance is a divine gift rather than merely a result of human effort.
